signed_rows.behavior: when the script's own init fails on a root that had no .terraform/, the script exits non-zero and the root has no .terraform/ afterwards
signed_rows.fails_when: the script exits 0 after the failed init, or .terraform/ still exists in that root

signed_rows.behavior: a root that already has .terraform/ is validated without init and keeps its .terraform/, even when validate fails
signed_rows.fails_when: the stub records an init call for that root, or its .terraform/ is gone after the run

signed_rows.behavior: a root with no .terraform/ whose init succeeds is initialized with -backend=false and then validated
signed_rows.fails_when: the stub does not record init -backend=false followed by validate for that root, or the script exits non-zero
just pre_commit or the cli test suite exits non-zero
signed_rows.command: just pre_commit && uv run --directory cli pytest -q
